data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2023 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding was $1,075.038m. The report discloses a material net deterioration in prior year reserves (net deterioration of $234.187m) driven by individual large losses and increased reserves on long-tail casualty lines together with inflationary pressures; the report does not disclose an aggregate GROSS prior-year movement amount, so a gross PYD figure could not be determined from the notes provided. Movement was concentrated in casualty/third-party liability (Specialty) lines while the 2023 catastrophe season was relatively benign, producing releases in some property/marine exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: this favourable catastrophe experience was offset by individual large loses and increased reserves on long tail casualty lines in older years.
a relatively benign natural catastrophe season
Future economic and social inflation are a material component due to the heightened inflation environment.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding taken from the Insurance Contract Liabilities (claims outstanding) movement table. The report only explicitly discloses a net prior-year deterioration (net $234.187m). A GROSS prior-year development figure is not stated in the 'movement in prior years' note; a gross PYD could in principle be derived from the gross claims development triangle but the triangle requires careful diagonal comparisons and contains an aggregated '2013 & prior' column; due to extraction constraints an authoritative gross PYD amount was not calculated and has been returned as null. Caveat: amounts in the report are presented in $000; primary monetary figures here are converted to millions (native USD) by dividing by 1,000.
